name: Lina Gálvez - § 1, après le point o - Am 6
title: REPORT on a European Parliament recommendation to the Council concerning the EU priorities for the 70th session of the UN Commission on the Status of Women
part_text: (oa) call for the Member States to guarantee equal pay for men and women in equal jobs, in a timely and fair manner, without overburdening procedures for employers, in compliance with national legislation;
